claim_boundary: For the two declared logarithmic axis-to-packet lifts, the frozen A6 contraction, selected real embedding, and norm-37 arithmetic Frobenius data preserve both orientations but supply no map selecting epsilon. This does not rule out a new theorem defining an analytic Frobenius action, a source density, a non-logarithmic link, C198 comparison, AFK identity, fusion, Stark, or TCC statement.

gate_outcome.remaining_design_problem: Derive a new analytic Frobenius/real-embedding/density theorem selecting epsilon, or explore a non-logarithmic axis-to-packet link without C198 fitting.

logarithmic_lifts.axis_orientation: s>0 is the frozen upper-half-plane approach

real_embedding_audit.orientation_role: It fixes the arithmetic positive-lift convention, not an action on s, Lambda, t, or epsilon.

two_sign_equivariance_audit.A6_action_on_epsilon: NOT_SUPPLIED; both covariant lifts remain admissible
two_sign_equivariance_audit.conclusion: The declared A6 axis, real embedding, and arithmetic Frobenius data do not select one of the two specified logarithmic lifts.
